name: h_rangeBlueOrangeSwitch
note: This is specifically for shooting a switch from behind a set of blue/orange pegs.

name: h_greatFairyFreeUpgrades
note: Represents having to throw a specific item into one of the Great Fairy pools in order to receive a reward.
In the vanilla game, it is required to have the Blue Boomerang to upgrade to the Red Boomerang;
in randomizers, it will typically be the case that the Great Fairies that give items won't require throwing specific items into the pool to receive a reward.

name: h_SahasrahlasRequest
note: In the vanilla game Sahasrahla gives link a reward for having the Green Pendant.
Randomizers may be interested in changing this requirement to requiring any pendant or no pendant.

name: h_NoAgahnimLoophole
note: This helper can be used in places where traversal is free unless Agahnim is defeated, but if you had the ability to defeat Agahnim,
i.e. sword or sufficient skill to kill Agahnim with swordless methods, then traversal is also free.
devNote: Typically would only apply to places where there are no enemies unless Agahnim is defeated.
So, this is a way to avoid canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess while still making traversal free.
This is assumed to not be true if Link is Bunny, as he wouldn't have the ability to use a sword.

name: h_MothulaVulnerableToGoldSword
note: In the vanilla game, Mothula is invulnerable to the gold sword, but vulnerable to all others.
Most randomizers would want to fix this, as it could create a canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess situation.
devNote: The requires of this helper should all be removed if Mothula takes damage to the gold sword.

name: h_castleNotLocked
note: In the vanilla game, the castle doors lock after Agahnim is defeated.
This helper is a combination of both enabling randomizers to easily not lock the door,
as well as some hand-waving of pretending the door is not locked, because in vanilla, you don't have a reason to enter the castle if Agahnim is defeated.
devNote: To model the game more accurately, there would need to be some sort of canRiskPermanentLossOfAccess tied to this helper.
This is especially true if door locations are randomized and there is a reason to go through these doors after Agahnim is defeated.

name: h_MiseryMireMedallion
note: The medallion required to open Misery Mire. Randomizers may wish to randomize this.

name: h_TurtleRockMedallion
note: The medallion required to open Turtle Rock. Randomizers may wish to randomize this.

name: h_SwampPalacePermanentFloodgates
note: In vanilla, the east and west floodgates are permanent. Randomizers may wish to disable this in order to prevent permanently losing access to the pot keys.
This helper is not used to flood the dungeon's entrance moat.

name: h_PullPedestalItem
note: In vanilla, three pendants are required to pull the Master Sword pedestal item. Randomizers may wish to change this.

name: h_OpenGanonsTower
note: In vanilla, seven crystals are required to open Ganon's Tower. Randomizers may wish to change this.

name: h_FortuneTellerPayment
devNote: FIXME: May take up to 30 rupees if Link has them.

name: h_jumpOffLedge
note: This is only technically required if Link is not able to return and pick up the big bomb before it explodes.

name: h_PegasusBootsBonk
note: The ability to dash into an object using Pegasus Boots. This can be done with Superbunny, but Link will revert to the base bunny form.

name: h_PegasusBootsNoBonk
note: The ability to dash using Pegasus Boots without needing to bonk. This can be done without losing the Superbunny form.

name: h_openChest
note: The ability to open a chest, which requires being in Link or Superbunny form.

name: h_purchaseItem
note: Purchasing an item will convert Lonk to Link and Bunny to Superbunny.

name: h_fallToLowerFloor
note: Falling in a pit to a lower floor will convert Lonk to Link and Bunny to Superbunny.
This also behaves the same way if Link enters the underworld from a drop entrance.

name: h_greatFairyThrowItem
note: Throwing an item to the great fairy ponds converts bunny to Lonk and Superbunny to Link.
